True transparent background and transparency in gaps between branches. 3:1 panoramic FULL CANVAS game layer, matching reference coordinate system. The main tree trunk is around x=12%, the second slender trunk around x=5%. Canopies are asymmetrical interlocking lobes with natural openings, similar to reference left trees but wholly newly painted. Leave the other 70% of canvas truly empty transparent. Do NOT enlarge to fill canvas. Avoid heavy borders or dark cast-shadow blocks.
